text:
maria: quick heads-up — opened a PR updating the migration guide and fixing an SDK example under /examples/python. CI reports all green except docs-preview is failing with a 404 on a static asset. who needs to review for examples + docs changes?

taylor: cc @docs team — FYI CODEOWNERS currently only covers /docs/** so examples don't auto-assign.

docs-bot: automated check: docs-preview — FAILED
Error: GET /static/js/snippet.js returned 404 in preview build

sam: can you paste the PR link and a brief diff summary? is this docs-only or touching runtime code?
maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — touches docs/ and examples/python/snippet.py only. no runtime changes.

jin: if examples should get docs review automatically we should add an entry to CODEOWNERS. proposed lines:

```
# Docs team for content + examples
/docs/ @redwood/docs
/examples/** @redwood/docs
```

maria: that makes sense. question: can we auto-merge docs-only fixes once docs-preview + lint pass? want to avoid manual churn for tiny link fixes.

taylor: we have auto-merge enabled for some repos but it's gated by GitHub settings and the CODEOWNERS review requirement. my preference: only auto-merge when: all checks pass, label `docs/ready` applied, and not in a release-freeze window.

sam: release calendar note — freeze starts next Thu 16:00 UTC for the release cut. if this lands before that and it's docs-only, still okay, but do we want to be conservative?

docs-bot: reminder: changing CODEOWNERS triggers reviews from the listed teams and may require admin approval to merge.

jin: for auto-merge we can add a tiny GH workflow that listens for label `docs/ready` and calls the merge API when checks are green. example workflow: 

```
name: Auto-merge docs
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled, unlabeled, synchronize]
jobs:
  auto-merge:
    if: github.event.label.name == 'docs/ready'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check status
        run: |
          STATUS=$(gh pr checks ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --repo ${{ github.repository }})
          echo "$STATUS"
      - name: Merge when green
        uses: pascalgn/automerge-action@v0.14.3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          merge_method: squash
          required_status_checks: docs-preview, lint
```

maria: note — docs-preview failed originally because examples/snippet imported `/static/js/snippet.js` which doesn't exist in preview. i replaced it with an inline snippet and removed the asset dependency; PR now passes docs-preview except for one image that 404s.

sam: LGTM on the approach. can we ensure the workflow excludes files under `examples/private/`? we don't want auto-merge on anything that references secrets or local keys.
jin: yes we can add a path filter or a small script to check diffs for dangerous filenames before auto-merging.

taylor: also prefer to hold merges during freeze. i'll add a check to ensure current date is outside the freeze window — if inside, workflow posts a comment and adds `hold` label.
maria: thanks — i'll update the PR description with the migration changelog and add `docs/ready` once CODEOWNERS PR merges.
docs-bot: note: CODEOWNERS PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/483 (adds /examples/** -> @redwood/docs).

sam: if CODEOWNERS merges today, i'll be OK with auto-merge once labels & checks are set — but please don't force-merge during freeze. :thumbsup:
taylor: I'll set the `hold` label to be applied automatically during freeze hours and will remove it Monday morning if everything is fine.
maria: perfect — thanks all. i'll ping when PR is labeled `docs/ready`.

(quick actions: jin to open CODEOWNERS PR, taylor to schedule hold rule, maria to fix last 404 and add label, sam to approve after checks)
